tuition.note: Per semester for most bachelor programmes (as of 1 Jan 2026); early-bird discounts of 1,000-2,000 EUR per year available

requirement.text: IB Diploma with at least 24 points (and Mathematics 4 SL / 3 HL), three A Levels at grade C or above, or a US high school certificate with GPA 3.0 plus AP/SAT/ACT results; otherwise a Foundation Programme and entrance exam. Interview in English; visa applicants need proof of English proficiency.
